name: pmt-lifecycle
description: PMT: project memory and lifecycle events with local or hosted storage.

python_path.title: Python 3.13+ executable
python_path.description: Absolute path of the Python 3.13 or later interpreter that runs PMT hooks, for example /opt/python3.13/bin/python3.13 or C:\Python313\python.exe.

host_url.title: PMT Host URL
host_url.description: HTTPS address of the Windows PMT Host, for example https://222.234.220.199:8765.

host_ca_file.title: Host CA certificate
host_ca_file.description: Absolute path of the Host's public root CA PEM. Leave empty when the Host certificate is publicly trusted.

device_id.title: Device ID
device_id.description: Device UUID issued by the PMT Host for this computer.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Actor name issued by the PMT Host for this device.

device_credential.title: Device credential
device_credential.description: Credential issued by the PMT Host for this device. Stored in Claude Code secure storage.

handoff_file.title: PMT handoff file
handoff_file.description: Optional pmt-handoff/v1 file. With a credential, connects this device to its PMT Host.
